rationale: Pinned Adventure Land game.js preloads every G.tilesets entry through the global Pixi loader. A full 8x Mainland world-atlas override would decode to roughly 1.55 GiB before unrelated textures. The safe baseline keeps the validated doors pilot at 8x and starts the remaining Mainland world atlases at 4x; higher scales require later live memory/performance evidence.

exceptionPolicy.reason: Global tileset preload makes simultaneous 8x world atlases exceed the initial Mainland decoded-texture budget.
